Hello, thank you for the appeal! I'm glad you like my OC.

Shion has a chaotic and mischievous personality. His weapon does not need to be drawn. 
When drawing his face, please do not draw his eye that is covered by his hair. If you do, Shion has a scar on his hidden eye that is like claw marks.

Here are some details about Shion:
- his flame magic is blue fireballs.
- he makes fireworks
- he can transform into a pink fox, a normal size or a big one
- his motif is aster flowers

I leave the rest up to you.

Thank you so much!

Hello! Thank you for your appeal! I would like to request commissions for two original characters I created.

■ Setting
It is a modern fantasy world. I live in a city. Alchemy, magic, etc. exist.

Heise / 187cm
[For appearance reference] https://toyhou.se/16259450.haize/gallery?key=0ndDrODhO3lr2Ej
She is complete, lovely, and sociable.
She is very ambitious and sometimes looks like a villain.
Author not yet ready for publication.

Link / 184cm
[appearance reference] https://toyhou.se/16259452.link/gallery?key=WfkKf8sxQXkuS1G
He is always irritated, but he doesn't show it.
He changes his personality to suit other people.
He is a back street doctor and used to be in the military.

Relationships
Childhood friend, acts like an ex-lover.
They have no romantic feelings for each other, but they are dating in a different distant world line.
Heise tends to irritate Link.

Outline
You can design and dress her in any outfit you like!
It doesn't matter if the hair is long or short.
You can use "stories, art galleries, movie theaters, azure skies, waterfront suicides" as motifs.
You can use any of these motifs.

If the amount is not enough, please appeal for an appropriate amount.
You can draw whatever you like! Your drawings are truly beautiful!
